name: ReceiptBatch_TransactionMatching_SQL
description: Read-only SQL preview of transaction-to-receipt match proposals. It performs no writes and is not wired into production matching.
command:
WITH
receipt_source AS (
    SELECT r.RECEIPT_ID,
           r.FILE_NAME,
           r.STATUS,
           r.REPORT_ID,
           r.CREDIT_TRANSACTION,
           r.TOTAL_AMOUNT,
           r.RECEIPT_DATE,
           r.MERCHANT,
           r.EXPENSE_TYPE,
           r.LOCATION,
           r.EXPENSE_DATA_JSON
    FROM   XX_AP_BATCH_RECEIPTS r
    WHERE  r.EBS_USER_NAME = UPPER(TRIM('${EBS_USER}'))
),
transaction_source AS (
    SELECT trxns.TRX_ID AS TRANSACTION_ID,
           trxns.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT AS TRANSACTION_AMOUNT,
           trxns.FOLIO_TYPE AS TRANSACTION_FOLIO_EXPENSE_TYPE,
               CASE
           /* Airfare */
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                    UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                    'AIRLINE|AIRWAYS|AIRLINES|AIR FARE|TRAVEL AGENCY|TRAVEL AGENT|LUFTHANSA|DELTA|UNITED|AMERICAN AIR|SOUTHWEST|MEXICANA|USAIRWAY|NORTHWEST|BRITISH AIR|AIR FRANCE|KLM|EL AL'
                )
               THEN 'Airfare'

           /* Car Rental */
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                    UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                    'RENT[- ]?A[- ]?CAR|RENTAL CAR|CAR RENTAL|AVIS|HERTZ|ENTERPRISE|BUDGET|DOLLAR RENT|NATIONAL CAR|ALAMO|SIXT'
                )
               THEN 'Car Rental'

           /* Entertainment */
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                    UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                    'CINEMA|MOVIE|THEATER|THEATRE|CONCERT|CLUB|NIGHTCLUB|AMUSEMENT|PARK|DISNEY|MUSEUM|GALLERY|EXHIBITION|CASINO|BOWLING|STADIUM|ARENA|TICKETS|EVENTBRITE|TICKETMASTER'
                )
               THEN 'Entertainment'

           /* Hotel */
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                    UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                    'HOTEL|MOTEL|INN|LODGE|RESORT|SUITES|MARRIOTT|HYATT|HILTON|HOLIDAY INN|FOUR SEASONS|SHERATON|WESTIN|CONRAD|EMBASSY SUITES|BEST WESTERN|RADISSON|COURTYARD|HAMPTON INN'
                )
               THEN 'Hotel'

           /* Meals */
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                    UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                    'RESTAURANT|GRILL|CAFE|CAFÉ|BISTRO|BUFFET|PIZZA|BURGER|SUSHI|STEAK|STEAKHOUSE|BBQ|BARBEQUE|DELI|DINER|MCDONALD|STARBUCKS|WENDY|HOOTERS|SUBWAY|TACO|CHILI|OLIVE GARDEN|RED LOBSTER|LOBSTER HOUSE|CHINESE FOOD'
                )
               THEN 'Meals'

           /* Taxis */
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                    UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                    'TAXI|TAXIS|UBER|LYFT|LIMO|LIMOUSINE|TRANSIT|METRO|RAIL|BAHN|BUS|SHUTTLE'
                )
               THEN 'Taxis'

           /* Telephone Calls */
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                    UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                    'AT%T|VERIZON|VODAFONE|ORANGE|TELECOM|TELEFONICA|TELEPHONE|PHONE CARD|CALLING CARD|SBC|SPRINT|T-MOBILE|SFR'
                )
               THEN 'Telephone Calls'

           /* Default */
           ELSE 'Miscellaneous'
       END AS TRANSACTION_EXPENSE_TYPE,
           TO_CHAR(trxns.TRANSACTION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRANSACTION_RECEIPT_DATE,
           trxns.MERCHANT_NAME1           AS TRANSACTION_MERCHANT,
           trxns.BILLED_AMOUNT AS TRANSACTION_BILLED_AMOUNT,
           trxns.BILLED_CURRENCY_CODE AS TRANSACTION_BILLED_CURRENCY,
           TO_CHAR(trxns.BILLED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRANSACTION_BILLED_DATE,
           trxns.POSTED_AMOUNT AS TRANSACTION_POSTED_AMOUNT,
           trxns.POSTED_CURRENCY_CODE AS TRANSACTION_POSTED_CURRENCY,
           TO_CHAR(trxns.POSTED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRANSACTION_POSTED_DATE,
           trxns.CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE AS TRANSACTION_EXCHANGE_RATE,
           trxns.CARD_ID AS TRANSACTION_CARD_ID,
           trxns.CARD_PROGRAM_ID AS TRANSACTION_CARD_PROGRAM_ID,
           trxns.MERCHANT_NAME2 AS TRANSACTION_MERCHANT_NAME2,
           trxns.MERCHANT_CITY AS TRANSACTION_CITY,
           trxns.MERCHANT_PROVINCE_STATE AS TRANSACTION_STATE,
           trxns.MERCHANT_COUNTRY AS TRANSACTION_COUNTRY,
           trxns.REFERENCE_NUMBER AS TRANSACTION_REFERENCE,
           trxns.DEBIT_FLAG AS TRANSACTION_DEBIT_FLAG,
           trxns.VALIDATE_CODE AS TRANSACTION_VALIDATE_CODE,
           trxns.CATEGORY AS TRANSACTION_CATEGORY,
           trxns.REPORT_HEADER_ID AS TRANSACTION_REPORT_ID,
           trxns.EXPENSED_AMOUNT AS TRANSACTION_EXPENSED_AMOUNT,
           TO_CHAR(trxns.TRX_AVAILABLE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRANSACTION_AVAILABLE_DATE,
           trxns.TRX_AVAILABLE_DATE AS TRANSACTION_AVAILABLE_DATE_RAW,
           trxns.DESCRIPTION AS TRANSACTION_DESCRIPTION,
           trxns.SIC_CODE AS TRANSACTION_SIC_CODE,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS TRANSACTION_TOTAL_COUNT
    FROM   ap_credit_card_trxns_all trxns
    JOIN   ap_cards_all cards
           ON cards.card_id = trxns.card_id
    JOIN   fnd_user fu
           ON fu.employee_id = cards.employee_id
    WHERE  fu.user_name = UPPER(TRIM('${EBS_USER}'))
),
linked_source AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
           LTRIM(TRIM(r.CREDIT_TRANSACTION), '0') AS TRANSACTION_ID
    FROM   XX_AP_BATCH_RECEIPTS r
    JOIN   transaction_source t
           ON TO_CHAR(t.TRANSACTION_ID) = LTRIM(TRIM(r.CREDIT_TRANSACTION), '0')
    WHERE  TRIM(r.CREDIT_TRANSACTION) IS NOT NULL
      AND  REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(r.CREDIT_TRANSACTION), '^0*[1-9][0-9]*$')
),
receipt_normalized AS (
    SELECT rs.RECEIPT_ID,
           rs.FILE_NAME,
           rs.STATUS,
           rs.REPORT_ID,
           rs.CREDIT_TRANSACTION,
           rs.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS RECEIPT_AMOUNT,
           TO_CHAR(rs.RECEIPT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RECEIPT_DATE_ISO,
           rs.RECEIPT_DATE AS RECEIPT_DATE_VALUE,
           rs.MERCHANT AS RECEIPT_MERCHANT,
           rs.EXPENSE_TYPE AS RECEIPT_EXPENSE_TYPE,
           rs.LOCATION AS RECEIPT_LOCATION,
           TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(rs.MERCHANT), '[[:space:]]+', ' ')) AS MERCHANT_NORM,
           TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(rs.EXPENSE_TYPE), '[[:space:]]+', ' ')) AS EXPENSE_TYPE_NORM,
           TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(rs.LOCATION), '[[:space:]]+', ' ')) AS LOCATION_NORM,
           UPPER(TRIM(rs.STATUS)) AS STATUS_NORM,
           TRIM(rs.CREDIT_TRANSACTION) AS CREDIT_NORM,
           TRIM(rs.REPORT_ID) AS REPORT_NORM,
           TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(
               UPPER(CASE WHEN rs.EXPENSE_DATA_JSON IS JSON THEN
                   JSON_VALUE(rs.EXPENSE_DATA_JSON,
                       '$.lines[0].receiptCurrency'
                       RETURNING VARCHAR2(100) NULL ON ERROR)
               END),
               '[[:space:]]+', ' ')) AS CURRENCY_NORMALIZED_TEXT
    FROM   receipt_source rs
),
receipt_currency AS (
    SELECT rn.*,
           CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(rn.CURRENCY_NORMALIZED_TEXT,
                                '^[A-Z]{3}( - .+)?$')
               THEN SUBSTR(rn.CURRENCY_NORMALIZED_TEXT, 1, 3)
               ELSE NULL
           END AS RECEIPT_CURRENCY
    FROM   receipt_normalized rn
),
receipt_assessed AS (
    SELECT rc.*,
           CASE
               WHEN rc.CREDIT_NORM IS NOT NULL THEN 'ALREADY_LINKED'
               WHEN rc.REPORT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'IN_REPORT'
               WHEN NVL(rc.STATUS_NORM, 'X') NOT IN ('PROCESSED', 'READY')
                   THEN 'NOT_READY'
               WHEN rc.RECEIPT_CURRENCY IS NULL THEN 'CURRENCY_MISSING'
               WHEN rc.RECEIPT_AMOUNT IS NULL
                    OR rc.RECEIPT_AMOUNT = 0
                    OR rc.RECEIPT_DATE_VALUE IS NULL
                    OR rc.MERCHANT_NORM IS NULL
                   THEN 'INCOMPLETE_RECEIPT'
               ELSE 'ELIGIBLE'
           END AS ASSESSED_STATUS
    FROM   receipt_currency rc
),
eligible_receipts AS (
    SELECT ra.*
    FROM   receipt_assessed ra
    WHERE  ra.ASSESSED_STATUS = 'ELIGIBLE'
),
transaction_normalized AS (
    SELECT ts.TRANSACTION_ID,
           ts.TRANSACTION_RECEIPT_DATE,
           TO_DATE(ts.TRANSACTION_RECEIPT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRANSACTION_DATE_VALUE,
           ts.TRANSACTION_MERCHANT,
           ts.TRANSACTION_EXPENSE_TYPE,
           ts.TRANSACTION_BILLED_AMOUNT,
           ts.TRANSACTION_BILLED_CURRENCY,
           ts.TRANSACTION_POSTED_AMOUNT,
           UPPER(TRIM(ts.TRANSACTION_POSTED_CURRENCY)) AS POSTED_CURRENCY_NORM,
           ts.TRANSACTION_CARD_ID,
           ts.TRANSACTION_REFERENCE,
           ts.TRANSACTION_VALIDATE_CODE,
           ts.TRANSACTION_REPORT_ID,
           ts.TRANSACTION_EXPENSED_AMOUNT,
           ts.TRANSACTION_CATEGORY,
           ts.TRANSACTION_AVAILABLE_DATE,
           ts.TRANSACTION_CITY,
           ts.TRANSACTION_STATE,
           TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(ts.TRANSACTION_MERCHANT), '[[:space:]]+', ' ')) AS MERCHANT_NORM,
           TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(ts.TRANSACTION_EXPENSE_TYPE), '[[:space:]]+', ' ')) AS EXPENSE_TYPE_NORM,
           TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(ts.TRANSACTION_CITY), '[[:space:]]+', ' ')) AS CITY_NORM,
           TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(ts.TRANSACTION_STATE), '[[:space:]]+', ' ')) AS STATE_NORM,
           CASE
               WHEN TRIM(ts.TRANSACTION_CITY) IS NOT NULL
                    AND TRIM(ts.TRANSACTION_STATE) IS NOT NULL
                   THEN TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(ts.TRANSACTION_CITY), '[[:space:]]+', ' '))
                        || ', '
                        || TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(ts.TRANSACTION_STATE), '[[:space:]]+', ' '))
               WHEN TRIM(ts.TRANSACTION_CITY) IS NOT NULL
                   THEN TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(ts.TRANSACTION_CITY), '[[:space:]]+', ' '))
               ELSE NULL
           END AS CITY_STATE_NORM,
           CASE
               WHEN UPPER(TRIM(ts.TRANSACTION_VALIDATE_CODE)) = 'Y'
                    AND ts.TRANSACTION_REPORT_ID IS NULL
                    AND NVL(ts.TRANSACTION_EXPENSED_AMOUNT, 0) = 0
                    AND (ts.TRANSACTION_CATEGORY IS NULL
                         OR UPPER(TRIM(ts.TRANSACTION_CATEGORY)) = 'BUSINESS')
                    AND (ts.TRANSACTION_AVAILABLE_DATE IS NULL
                         OR ts.TRANSACTION_AVAILABLE_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
                    AND ts.TRANSACTION_POSTED_AMOUNT IS NOT NULL
                    AND TRIM(ts.TRANSACTION_POSTED_CURRENCY) IS NOT NULL
                    AND ts.TRANSACTION_RECEIPT_DATE IS NOT NULL
                    AND TRIM(ts.TRANSACTION_MERCHANT) IS NOT NULL
                    AND NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM   linked_source ls
                        WHERE  ls.TRANSACTION_ID = TO_CHAR(ts.TRANSACTION_ID)
                    )
                   THEN 'Y'
               ELSE 'N'
           END AS ELIGIBLE_FLAG
    FROM   transaction_source ts
),
eligible_transactions AS (
    SELECT tn.*
    FROM   transaction_normalized tn
    WHERE  tn.ELIGIBLE_FLAG = 'Y'
),
pairs AS (
    SELECT er.RECEIPT_ID,
           et.TRANSACTION_ID,
           er.RECEIPT_AMOUNT,
           er.RECEIPT_CURRENCY,
           er.RECEIPT_DATE_ISO,
           er.RECEIPT_MERCHANT,
           er.RECEIPT_EXPENSE_TYPE,
           er.RECEIPT_LOCATION,
           et.TRANSACTION_POSTED_AMOUNT,
           et.POSTED_CURRENCY_NORM,
           et.TRANSACTION_RECEIPT_DATE,
           et.TRANSACTION_MERCHANT,
           et.TRANSACTION_EXPENSE_TYPE,
           et.CITY_STATE_NORM,
           et.TRANSACTION_CARD_ID,
           et.TRANSACTION_REFERENCE,
           et.TRANSACTION_BILLED_AMOUNT,
           et.TRANSACTION_BILLED_CURRENCY,
           ABS(TRUNC(er.RECEIPT_DATE_VALUE) - et.TRANSACTION_DATE_VALUE) AS DATE_DIFF_DAYS,
           CASE WHEN er.MERCHANT_NORM = et.MERCHANT_NORM THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MERCHANT_MATCH,
           CASE WHEN er.EXPENSE_TYPE_NORM IS NOT NULL
                     AND et.EXPENSE_TYPE_NORM IS NOT NULL
                     AND er.EXPENSE_TYPE_NORM = et.EXPENSE_TYPE_NORM
                THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXPENSE_TYPE_MATCH,
           CASE WHEN er.LOCATION_NORM IS NOT NULL
                     AND et.CITY_STATE_NORM IS NOT NULL
                     AND (er.LOCATION_NORM = et.CITY_NORM
                          OR er.LOCATION_NORM = et.CITY_STATE_NORM)
                THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LOCATION_MATCH,
           40 + 25
           + CASE WHEN ABS(TRUNC(er.RECEIPT_DATE_VALUE) - et.TRANSACTION_DATE_VALUE) = 0 THEN 15
                  WHEN ABS(TRUNC(er.RECEIPT_DATE_VALUE) - et.TRANSACTION_DATE_VALUE) = 1 THEN 10
                  ELSE 5
             END
           + CASE WHEN er.MERCHANT_NORM = et.MERCHANT_NORM THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN er.EXPENSE_TYPE_NORM IS NOT NULL
                       AND et.EXPENSE_TYPE_NORM IS NOT NULL
                       AND er.EXPENSE_TYPE_NORM = et.EXPENSE_TYPE_NORM
                  THEN 5 ELSE 0
             END
           + CASE WHEN er.LOCATION_NORM IS NOT NULL
                       AND et.CITY_STATE_NORM IS NOT NULL
                       AND (er.LOCATION_NORM = et.CITY_NORM
                            OR er.LOCATION_NORM = et.CITY_STATE_NORM)
                  THEN 5 ELSE 0
             END AS MATCH_SCORE
    FROM   eligible_receipts er
    JOIN   eligible_transactions et
           ON er.RECEIPT_AMOUNT = et.TRANSACTION_POSTED_AMOUNT
          AND er.RECEIPT_CURRENCY = et.POSTED_CURRENCY_NORM
          AND ABS(TRUNC(er.RECEIPT_DATE_VALUE) - et.TRANSACTION_DATE_VALUE) <= 3
),
pair_degrees AS (
    SELECT p.*,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.RECEIPT_ID) AS RECEIPT_CANDIDATE_COUNT,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.TRANSACTION_ID) AS TRX_RECEIPT_COUNT
    FROM   pairs p
),
pair_ranked AS (
    SELECT pd.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY pd.RECEIPT_ID
               ORDER BY pd.MATCH_SCORE DESC,
                        pd.DATE_DIFF_DAYS ASC,
                        pd.TRANSACTION_ID ASC
           ) AS CANDIDATE_RANK
    FROM   pair_degrees pd
),
pair_rows AS (
    SELECT pr.RECEIPT_ID,
           pr.RECEIPT_MERCHANT,
           pr.RECEIPT_EXPENSE_TYPE,
           pr.RECEIPT_LOCATION,
           pr.RECEIPT_AMOUNT,
           pr.RECEIPT_CURRENCY,
           pr.RECEIPT_DATE_ISO,
           pr.TRANSACTION_ID,
           pr.TRANSACTION_POSTED_AMOUNT,
           pr.POSTED_CURRENCY_NORM,
           pr.TRANSACTION_RECEIPT_DATE,
           pr.TRANSACTION_MERCHANT,
           pr.TRANSACTION_EXPENSE_TYPE,
           pr.CITY_STATE_NORM,
           pr.TRANSACTION_CARD_ID,
           pr.TRANSACTION_REFERENCE,
           pr.TRANSACTION_BILLED_AMOUNT,
           pr.TRANSACTION_BILLED_CURRENCY,
           pr.DATE_DIFF_DAYS,
           pr.MERCHANT_MATCH,
           pr.EXPENSE_TYPE_MATCH,
           pr.LOCATION_MATCH,
           pr.MATCH_SCORE,
           CASE
               WHEN pr.RECEIPT_CANDIDATE_COUNT > 1
                    OR pr.TRX_RECEIPT_COUNT > 1
                   THEN 'AMBIGUOUS'
               WHEN pr.DATE_DIFF_DAYS = 0
                    AND pr.MERCHANT_MATCH = 'Y'
                   THEN 'UNIQUE_EXACT'
               ELSE 'REVIEW'
           END AS MATCH_STATUS,
           CASE
               WHEN pr.RECEIPT_CANDIDATE_COUNT > 1
                    AND pr.TRX_RECEIPT_COUNT > 1
                   THEN 'Receipt has ' || pr.RECEIPT_CANDIDATE_COUNT
                        || ' candidates and the candidate transaction has '
                        || pr.TRX_RECEIPT_COUNT
                        || ' competing receipts. No candidate is selected by sort order.'
               WHEN pr.RECEIPT_CANDIDATE_COUNT > 1
                   THEN 'Receipt has ' || pr.RECEIPT_CANDIDATE_COUNT
                        || ' candidates. No candidate is selected by sort order.'
               WHEN pr.TRX_RECEIPT_COUNT > 1
                   THEN 'The candidate transaction has ' || pr.TRX_RECEIPT_COUNT
                        || ' competing receipts. No candidate is selected by sort order.'
               WHEN pr.DATE_DIFF_DAYS = 0
                    AND pr.MERCHANT_MATCH = 'Y'
                   THEN 'Mutual unique candidate with the same calendar date and exact normalized merchant. Preview only.'
               ELSE 'Mutual unique candidate but the calendar date or normalized merchant differs. Review required.'
           END AS MATCH_REASON,
           pr.RECEIPT_CANDIDATE_COUNT,
           pr.TRX_RECEIPT_COUNT,
           pr.CANDIDATE_RANK
    FROM   pair_ranked pr
),
unpaired_rows AS (
    SELECT ra.RECEIPT_ID,
           ra.RECEIPT_MERCHANT,
           ra.RECEIPT_EXPENSE_TYPE,
           ra.RECEIPT_LOCATION,
           ra.RECEIPT_AMOUNT,
           ra.RECEIPT_CURRENCY,
           ra.RECEIPT_DATE_ISO,
           CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS TRANSACTION_ID,
           CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS TRANSACTION_POSTED_AMOUNT,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(3)) AS POSTED_CURRENCY_NORM,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS TRANSACTION_RECEIPT_DATE,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS TRANSACTION_MERCHANT,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS TRANSACTION_EXPENSE_TYPE,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(400)) AS CITY_STATE_NORM,
           CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS TRANSACTION_CARD_ID,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS TRANSACTION_REFERENCE,
           CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS TRANSACTION_BILLED_AMOUNT,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(3)) AS TRANSACTION_BILLED_CURRENCY,
           CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS DATE_DIFF_DAYS,
           CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS MERCHANT_MATCH,
           CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS EXPENSE_TYPE_MATCH,
           CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS LOCATION_MATCH,
           CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS MATCH_SCORE,
           CASE
               WHEN ra.ASSESSED_STATUS = 'ELIGIBLE' THEN 'NO_CANDIDATE'
               ELSE ra.ASSESSED_STATUS
           END AS MATCH_STATUS,
           CASE ra.ASSESSED_STATUS
               WHEN 'ALREADY_LINKED' THEN 'Receipt has a nonblank CREDIT_TRANSACTION. The existing link is preserved and no candidate is proposed.'
               WHEN 'IN_REPORT' THEN 'Receipt REPORT_ID is not null. The receipt is already in a report and no candidate is proposed.'
               WHEN 'NOT_READY' THEN 'Receipt status is not PROCESSED or READY. No candidate is proposed.'
               WHEN 'CURRENCY_MISSING' THEN 'Receipt currency is missing, malformed, or ambiguous. No default or inferred currency is applied.'
               WHEN 'INCOMPLETE_RECEIPT' THEN 'Receipt amount is zero or null, or the receipt date or merchant is missing. No candidate is proposed.'
               ELSE 'No eligible transaction matched the exact posted amount, normalized currency, and calendar date within 3 days after eligibility and global reservation checks. Expense type and location are supporting signals only.'
           END AS MATCH_REASON,
           0 AS RECEIPT_CANDIDATE_COUNT,
           0 AS TRX_RECEIPT_COUNT,
           CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS CANDIDATE_RANK
    FROM   receipt_assessed ra
    WHERE  ra.ASSESSED_STATUS <> 'ELIGIBLE'
       OR  NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM   pair_ranked pr
               WHERE  pr.RECEIPT_ID = ra.RECEIPT_ID
           )
),
result_rows AS (
    SELECT * FROM pair_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM unpaired_rows
),
globals AS (
    SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM receipt_source) AS TOTAL_RECEIPTS,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible_receipts) AS ELIGIBLE_RECEIPTS,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible_transactions) AS ELIGIBLE_TRANSACTIONS
    FROM   DUAL
),
final_rows AS (
    SELECT rr.RECEIPT_ID,
           rs.FILE_NAME AS RECEIPT_FILE_NAME,
           rs.STATUS AS RECEIPT_STATUS,
           rs.REPORT_ID AS RECEIPT_REPORT_ID,
           rs.CREDIT_TRANSACTION AS EXISTING_TRANSACTION_ID,
           rr.RECEIPT_AMOUNT,
           rr.RECEIPT_CURRENCY,
           rr.RECEIPT_DATE_ISO AS RECEIPT_DATE,
           rr.RECEIPT_MERCHANT,
           rr.RECEIPT_EXPENSE_TYPE,
           rr.RECEIPT_LOCATION,
           rr.TRANSACTION_ID,
           rr.TRANSACTION_POSTED_AMOUNT AS TRANSACTION_AMOUNT,
           rr.POSTED_CURRENCY_NORM AS TRANSACTION_CURRENCY,
           rr.TRANSACTION_RECEIPT_DATE AS TRANSACTION_DATE,
           rr.TRANSACTION_MERCHANT,
           rr.TRANSACTION_EXPENSE_TYPE,
           rr.CITY_STATE_NORM AS TRANSACTION_LOCATION,
           rr.TRANSACTION_CARD_ID,
           rr.TRANSACTION_REFERENCE,
           rr.TRANSACTION_BILLED_AMOUNT AS BILLED_AMOUNT,
           rr.TRANSACTION_BILLED_CURRENCY AS BILLED_CURRENCY,
           rr.DATE_DIFF_DAYS,
           rr.MERCHANT_MATCH,
           rr.EXPENSE_TYPE_MATCH,
           rr.LOCATION_MATCH,
           rr.MATCH_SCORE,
           CASE
               WHEN g.TOTAL_RECEIPTS = 0 THEN 'NO_RECEIPTS'
               ELSE rr.MATCH_STATUS
           END AS MATCH_STATUS,
           CASE
               WHEN g.TOTAL_RECEIPTS = 0
                   THEN 'No receipts were found for this EBS_USER. One summary row is returned and no receipt or transaction is invented.'
               ELSE rr.MATCH_REASON
           END AS MATCH_REASON,
           rr.RECEIPT_CANDIDATE_COUNT,
           rr.TRX_RECEIPT_COUNT,
           rr.CANDIDATE_RANK,
           g.TOTAL_RECEIPTS,
           g.ELIGIBLE_RECEIPTS,
           g.ELIGIBLE_TRANSACTIONS,
           'Y' AS PREVIEW_ONLY
    FROM   globals g
    LEFT JOIN result_rows rr
           ON 1 = 1
    LEFT JOIN receipt_source rs
           ON rs.RECEIPT_ID = rr.RECEIPT_ID
)
SELECT f.RECEIPT_ID,
       f.RECEIPT_FILE_NAME,
       f.RECEIPT_STATUS,
       f.RECEIPT_REPORT_ID,
       f.EXISTING_TRANSACTION_ID,
       f.RECEIPT_AMOUNT,
       f.RECEIPT_CURRENCY,
       f.RECEIPT_DATE,
       f.RECEIPT_MERCHANT,
       f.RECEIPT_EXPENSE_TYPE,
       f.RECEIPT_LOCATION,
       f.TRANSACTION_ID,
       f.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT,
       f.TRANSACTION_CURRENCY,
       f.TRANSACTION_DATE,
       f.TRANSACTION_MERCHANT,
       f.TRANSACTION_EXPENSE_TYPE,
       f.TRANSACTION_LOCATION,
       f.TRANSACTION_CARD_ID,
       f.TRANSACTION_REFERENCE,
       f.BILLED_AMOUNT,
       f.BILLED_CURRENCY,
       f.DATE_DIFF_DAYS,
       f.MERCHANT_MATCH,
       f.EXPENSE_TYPE_MATCH,
       f.LOCATION_MATCH,
       f.MATCH_SCORE,
       f.MATCH_STATUS,
       f.MATCH_REASON,
       f.RECEIPT_CANDIDATE_COUNT,
       f.TRX_RECEIPT_COUNT,
       f.CANDIDATE_RANK,
       f.TOTAL_RECEIPTS,
       f.ELIGIBLE_RECEIPTS,
       f.ELIGIBLE_TRANSACTIONS,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS TOTAL_RESULT_ROWS,
       f.PREVIEW_ONLY
FROM   final_rows f
